title: §.XI Chemnitz: From 1546 our side used this edition in every diet as the Augustana — no error in the 1542 declarations except Art. X mutilation
pass_a_gloss: So from the Year 46 and afterward in all Diets and Actions concerning Religion our people betook themselves to this Edition, which they called the Augsburg Confession. Nor can it be demonstrated that there is anything of errors or of corruptions in those declarations which were added in the Edition of the Year 42, except the mutilation in the Tenth Article.
pass_b_english: "So from 1546 on, in every diet and religious proceeding, our side kept turning to this edition — and they called it the Augsburg Confession.
No one can show errors or corruptions in the declarations added in the 1542 edition, save the mutilation in Article X."
source_text: Ita ab Anno 46. & postea in omnibus Comitiis & Actionibus de Religione ad hanc Editionem se nostri contulerunt, quam vocarunt Confessionem Augustanam. Nec potest demonstrari, quod aliquid sit vel errorum, vel depravationum in illis declarationibus, quae in Editione Anno 42. accesserunt, exceptâ mutilatione in X. Articulo.
